backend/main.mo: Minimal Motoko backend actor with no methods or state defined.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report file with an empty features list.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: JSON document summarizing each frontend source file's purpose and key content for build planning reference.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind CSS entry file that defines OKLCH-based CSS custom properties for light and dark themes including colors, borders, and sidebar tokens.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point titled 'Come Back Saachi' that mounts the React app via a root div and module script.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root React component rendering a Slytherin-themed page with a fixed background image, floating particles, a main reconnection card with yes/no buttons, and a footer; switches to CelebrationScreen on 'Yes'.
frontend/src/components/CelebrationScree: Celebration component that displays Slytherin-colored confetti, floating magical emoji particles, and an animated card with affectionate messages after the user clicks 'Yes'.
frontend/src/components/FloatingHearts.t: Background decoration component rendering 22 randomly positioned Harry Potter-themed emoji particles that float upward with varied speeds and opacities.
frontend/src/components/RunawayButton.ts: A 'No' button that runs away on hover/touch to a random screen position and displays one of 20 Harry Potter-themed quip bubbles each time.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Custom hook that creates and caches an ICP backend actor via React Query, using the current Internet Identity or an anonymous identity, and invalidates dependent queries when the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides an InternetIdentityProvider and useInternetIdentity hook for managing ICP Internet Identity authentication state, including login, logout, and identity persistence via AuthClient.
frontend/src/index.css: Global CSS file that defines a Harry Potter/Slytherin-themed dark design system using OKLCH color tokens, imports Cinzel and Crimson Text fonts, sets up Tailwind layers, and declares custom utility classes and keyframe animations.
frontend/src/main.tsx: React app entry point that mounts the app with QueryClientProvider for data fetching and InternetIdentityProvider for ICP authentication wrapping the root App component.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration extending the theme with Slytherin-palette color tokens (emerald, silver, dark-stone), custom fonts, border radii, box shadows, and accordion keyframe animations, plus typography and container-queries plugins.
project_state.json: Project state document (version 35) describing a Harry Potter/Slytherin-themed webpage asking 'Saachi' to reconnect, capturing architectural rules, known issues, and a list of existing implemented features.
